findings.action: Protected baseline evaluation omits baseline mandatory-human obligations. With an adopted baseline using never plus mandatory-human, a scope removing that human requirement is evaluated by evaluateCloseoutReview(base), which returns exempt; mandatoryHumanReview then examines only the current policy/profiles. The contract-changing scope can therefore exempt itself despite the protected baseline. The earlier !base.Enabled return also discards an adopted baseline's always setting even though adopted always otherwise survives enabled=false. Restore the complete effective baseline obligation, loading baseline profiles at the baseline revision.

closedByReceipt verifies composition and absence of a negative verdict, rather than the applicable review verification. After an exempt close, voluntarily sealing a review bundle without completing its attestation makes scopeReviewRecorded prevent exemption and leaves ReviewCheck/closeout state unapproved, but closedByReceipt still returns true. ReachedMilestones, attention, RoadmapReached and doctor can consequently suppress a scope whose closeout verifier is nonterminal. Use the applicable verifier, including incomplete or invalid recorded review history, for these projections.

The published receipt schema forbids additional properties but does not declare exit_gate_digest. NewCloseoutReceipt always supplies a milestone gate digest and CloseoutReceipt serializes it at closeout_receipt.go:34, so normally emitted milestone receipts violate their published schema. Add the emitted field and cover producer-to-schema conformance. Static schema inspection confirmed additionalProperties=false and exit_gate_digest absent.

Historical done roadmaps are treated as interrupted closes. When closeoutReviewGate deliberately returns no decision for a positively established legacy closure, preflight calls CloseoutRecoveryDecision and can publish a new receipt under today's policy. This violates the no-backfill requirement. Once that roadmap receipt exists, closeoutScopeHistorical no longer recognizes its receipt-less historical milestones, potentially reopening them under the adopted policy. Preserve an already-terminal historical roadmap as a read-only verified close; distinguish it from genuine recovery.

Backward roadmap declarations are only parsed and compared by slug/project; their local targets are never resolved. An ADR declaring roadmaps: [roadmap:missing] passes syntax validation, is silently excluded, and can establish a when-justified exemption with Known=true. The specification requires unresolved explicit association inputs to remain unknown. Resolve local declared targets and diagnose missing or ambiguous targets before proving association absence.

README.md is still skipped unless a forward association already found it. A valid backward declaration or local roadmap link in that file is therefore invisible, although README.md is accepted as an ADR basename and the specification calls for a complete .pose/adr/*.md inventory. A multi-member roadmap can incorrectly receive a when-justified exemption. Read backward associations consistently for every supported ADR basename.

mandatoryHumanReview applies every same-kind human overlay regardless of its selectors or adoption cutoff. ReviewPlan filters both before composing independence at review_plan.go:316-350. Thus a nonmatching or prospectively inapplicable overlay forces an aggregate review under never/when-justified even when the effective plan has no human obligation. Resolve the same applicable overlays as the plan instead of imposing a broader requirement.

Roadmap receipts bind only the union of members: closeoutSubject leaves their gate digest empty and omits roadmap cut criteria. After an exempt roadmap close, adding an unmet cut criterion such as C1: manual-review:docs/missing.md leaves the receipt standing. GetCloseoutState does not evaluate those criteria, and receipt preflight returns success before cmdRoadmapCheck runs. Consequently repeated close can report terminal success while roadmap-check fails. Bind the roadmap's semantic cut contract and preserve its gate verification independently of later policy.
